description: Guarantee that a sidecar narration push actually SUBMITS in the orchestrator pane by unifying both send paths on one verify loop with bare-submit remediation, and by splitting the push event taxonomy so a recovered push is distinguishable from a terminal failure.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirms the two facts the fix rests on: without -l, send-keys performs key-name lookup, so a bare `send-keys -t <pane> Enter` transmits the Enter KEY (not the literal text 'Enter'), and -l disables that lookup for every argument (the CAM-55 gotcha). Also confirms an argument-less send-keys falls back to 'the key the command is bound to', so the remediation must always pass exactly one explicit 'Enter' argv element and never zero args.
